hero.title:
Your Own Calendly.
Built In.
hero.description: Create shareable booking links that let anyone schedule time with you — with smart slot generation, buffer time, and race condition protection.

body: Create unlimited scheduling links — URLs like habos.app/s/mathias-30min — where guests book with zero friction and no account required. Smart slot generation considers duration, business hours, buffer time, and existing calendar events. Configurable pre and post-meeting padding blocks overlapping slots automatically. Server-side re-checks prevent double-bookings even under concurrent requests. Guests get confirmation emails with one-click cancel links.

mockCard.name: Mathias Haughom
mockCard.caption: Share the link anywhere — email signature, website, social bio. Guests book without creating an account.

slotGeneration.title: Smart slot generation
slotGeneration.desc: Duration, business hours, buffer time, and existing calendar events all factor in. Only truly available slots are shown — no back-and-forth.

buffer.title: 15-min buffer built in
buffer.desc: Configurable pre and post-meeting padding blocks overlapping slots automatically. No more back-to-back calls with no break.

selfService.title: Guest self-service
selfService.desc: Confirmation email includes a one-click cancel link. Guests cancel or reschedule without contacting you. You get notified.

beforeAfter.withoutText: Pay $12/mo for Calendly. Copy availability from your calendar. Hope it syncs. Manually add the booking to your CRM. Send the invoice separately.
beforeAfter.withText: Create a scheduling link. Share it. Guest books. Calendar, CRM, order, and notification all update automatically. Already included in your plan.

closing.title:
Other scheduling tools are a separate subscription.
HABOS scheduling is built in.
